alias: Cameras: all clear after a pushed fault
description: Says once on the phone that a camera fault which PUSHED has recovered. Each fault automation that pushes fires camera_alert_pushed, which sensor.camera_alert_ledger keeps open. Every 5 min this checks each open card against its own recovery test - the fault indicator clear for the same hold its recovered automation uses, plus per-camera evidence for partial loss and door coverage and an active fleet for motion-dead and fresh monitor heartbeats for a stall - pushes 'Cleared: <title>' and closes it. A card whose indicator has been clear for a day without that evidence (a flagged camera went stale, a door aged out of the record) closes silently: nothing confirmed a recovery, so nothing claims one. Card dismissals play no part, and a person's dismissal or a manual Run of a recovered automation changes nothing. Holds are measured from the indicator's last change, so a restart restarts them; the stalled card also needs each monitor's own heartbeat to move past both the push and the moment the stall cleared, so a restart's first publication is not taken for a recovery. Faults that never pushed are never opened.

"camera_door_coverage": ["camera_door_coverage_problem", 60], "camera_motion_fleet_drop": ["camera_motion_fleet_drop", 0], "scrypted_quiet_logs_undone": ["scrypted_quiet_logs_undone", 0], "camera_health_monitor_down": ["camera_health_monitor_reporting", 5], "camera_motion_monitor_down": ["camera_motion_monitor_reporting", 5], "camera_partial_loss_down": ["camera_partial_loss_test_reporting", 5], "camera_log_archive_down": ["camera_engine_log_archive", 0]} %}{% set B = inp.b %}{% set ns = namespace(out=[]) %}{% set dk = B.get('camera_push_decrypt_ok') elif card in ['camera_health_monitor_down', 'camera_motion_monitor_down', 'camera_partial_loss_down'] %}{% set v = 'clear' if onh else none %}{% elif card == 'camera_monitor_stalled' %}{% set floor = or not released %}{% set ok.v = false %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% set v = 'clear' if off and ok.v else ('silent' if off_day else none) %}{% elif card == 'camera_door_coverage' %}{% for c, saw0 in
